scenarios.name: b6_trip_windy_peak
scenarios.description: Full loss of the SSCO-NORT boundary (both circuits) at 17:00 on a high-wind winter evening peak. Scotland islands with surplus wind while England loses its northern imports. An N-2 boundary outage is a real planning contingency, and it is the only variant where a network-blind dispatch actually sheds load.

scenarios.name: cold_snap
scenarios.description: National demand 18% above normal for six hours from 15:00.

scenarios.name: nuclear_outage_low_wind
scenarios.description: 90% of EAST dispatchable capacity lost with wind at 25% across Scotland.
